summary: E2E backend + spot frontend testing of the virtue-system bug fixes and related features. All 4 backend tests pass (virtud +1 from caracteristicas, Perfeccionamiento tope 20, Maestría pericia, editor virtud PUT). Frontend spot-checks confirm CharactersListPage filters, RulesPage virtue Editor modal (Nueva Virtud + Editar) all wire up correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: drafts.py step5 correctly starts from `caracteristicas` (real wizard) with fallback to `atributos_finales`, applies fijas + chosen +1 + Perfeccionamiento with min(20, x+bonus) tope. Recalculating atributos_finales from caracteristicas each call is idempotent (safe on step5 revisits).
finalize persists virtud_caracteristica_elegida and merges virtud_pericia_elegida into pericia_elegida.
PUT /api/data/virtudes/{id} directly updates virtues collection; consumed via Editor modal.
filter-clear only renders when a filter is active (documented behavior); considering rendering it always disabled might be nicer UX but not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a TEST_Iter100_* character or draft and deletes it in finally blocks. Editor test edits first virtue's descripcion and restores original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_virtue_bugs_iter100.py for regressions on Perfeccionamiento tope 20, Maestría pericia, virtue +1 with real wizard flow (no step4), and PUT /api/data/virtudes/{id}. Cultura Hombres de Bree ID: 3ea83f21-2e16-4d65-bf5c-33ef16e50160. Not tested via automation: (a) BackgroundCard summary-virtud-block rendering (would need a finalized character sheet), (b) Hobbits sin botas (frontend-only Step7 filter — code inspected: filter present in Step7Equipment.jsx L143-154), (c) mount-rider-load-{mountId} (data-testid exists in DistributionView.jsx L307 but requires an equipped mount to test), (d) SheetPage1/2 portrait page assignment (needs sheet-editor manipulation). These match the code and match the request; recommend manual verification if any regressions arise.
rca of the issue: No issues reproduced. iter98/99 root cause (finalize using base caracteristicas) already fixed. iter100 confirms step5 also correctly starts from caracteristicas so the +1 is present in atributos_finales before finalize, and Perfeccionamiento/Maestría wiring works end-to-end.
